body:
I step out onto the platform, the cool evening air whipping around me as I approach the waiting area. The sight before me makes my anger wane slightly—people milling about, luggage strewn across the floor, all except for one figure standing quietly at the end of the row. His face turns pale under the harsh overhead lights, his eyes wide with fear. He holds an old newspaper, pages torn from its binding, and he seems to be reading aloud something urgent on it.

My initial urge to confront has softened into curiosity. If this man had just seen something so horrifying, why hide? What does he hope to achieve?
